anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool used to generate the BIDS report/organize the data; it does not describe this tDCS motor imagery dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: EEG-BIDS is a data-organization standard/extension the dataset follows; it does not describe this tDCS motor imagery dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a Brain Products system at 5000 Hz sampling rate with 60 Hz line noise present. Participants completed motor imagery tasks across 3 recording sessions. Data were organized and processed using MNE-BIDS (version 0.6.0) in compliance with BIDS 1.7.0 standards.
